Bare text followed by a paragraph inside a blockquote gets a blank-line separator instead of merging into one line

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<blockquote>Just text, then <p>a paragraph</p></blockquote>')
puts result.content.inspect
```
